purpose: Confirm the post-r2 output-isolation classification on two fresh cache-off servers without retroactively weakening r2's failed sequential-identity gate.

identity.gpu: one Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GiB

measurement.required_output_gate: 128 complete raw token IDs per response, zero reused prompt tokens, and no generated token digest equal to a frozen sequential oracle from another base task
measurement.required_stability_gate: both fresh attempts pass; relative range at every point <=10%
measurement.sequential_identity: reported but not required; r2 established intrinsic batch-shape variation above two users
